scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && concurrently -k -n pkg,api,web -c gray,cyan,magenta "npm run watch:packages" "npm run dev -w @veripay/api" "npm run dev -w @veripay/web"
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:packages && npm run dev -w @veripay/api
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @veripay/api && npm run build -w @veripay/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.clean: rm -rf apps/*/dist packages/*/dist apps/*/*.tsbuildinfo packages/*/*.tsbuildinfo coverage
